metadata.title: Login Page and Zitadel OIDC Authentication

story.iWant: to log in with my corporate credentials via Zitadel OIDC
story.soThat: I can securely access the system without managing passwords

tasks.task: Create login page component at /login route (AC: #1, #2)
Implement authorization code exchange with backend (AC: #6, #7)
Implement JWT token storage and user context (AC: #8, #9)
Create protected route guard and redirect logic (AC: #12)
Implement error handling and user feedback (AC: #14)

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Page displays Zitadel logo and "Sign in with corporate SSO" button
Clicking button redirects to Zitadel authorization endpoint with correct parameters (client_id, redirect_uri, response_type=code, scope=openid profile email)
After authentication, Zitadel redirects to /auth/callback route with code parameter
Frontend exchanges code for JWT token (via backend: POST /api/v1/auth/callback?code=...)
Backend calls Zitadel's token endpoint to exchange code for JWT
Frontend receives JWT and stores in secure session storage (NOT localStorage)
User context updated with: userId, email, name, roles (from JWT claims)
User redirected to /dashboard on successful login
Logout button clears session storage, redirects to /login
Protected routes check for valid token; redirect to /login if missing or expired
Token refresh: if access token near expiration, automatically refresh via refresh token
Error messages displayed on login failure: "Authentication failed", "Invalid credentials", or "Server error"
Loading state while exchanging code for token (spinner displayed)

doc.section: Story 3.2: Login Page and Zitadel OIDC Authentication
doc.snippet: Defines Zitadel OIDC login flow, authentication parameters, JWT token management, and required user context fields including userId, email, name, and roles for access control.

doc.title: Architecture Documentation

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: PRD specifies OIDC/Zitadel as authentication provider, JWT token-based API access, role-based access control (customer_service_agent, compliance_officer, admin), and session management requirements.

doc.snippet: Provides guidance on local development environment setup including Node.js, npm, Zitadel dev instance configuration, and development server configuration.

constraint.rule: JWT tokens MUST be stored in sessionStorage (session-scoped), NOT localStorage (persistent). This ensures tokens are cleared when browser closes.
Use Authorization Code Flow (not Implicit). Frontend must include client_id, redirect_uri, response_type=code, scope=openid profile email in authorization request.
User-friendly error messages must be displayed for: invalid credentials, network failures, token exchange failures. Never expose internal error details.
Protected routes must check for valid JWT token on each navigation. If token missing or expired, redirect to /login immediately.
Implement automatic token refresh before expiration. If refresh fails, force logout and redirect to /login.
Extract userId, email, name, roles from JWT claims. Roles determine access control for subsequent stories (audit log, reports, admin sections).

interface.name: Zitadel Authorization Endpoint
interface.description: Frontend redirects user to Zitadel for authentication. Zitadel handles login and redirects back to /auth/callback with authorization code.

interface.name: Backend Token Exchange Endpoint
interface.signature: POST /api/v1/auth/callback?code={CODE} → {data: {token: JWT, user: {userId, email, name, roles}}}
interface.description: Frontend calls backend to exchange authorization code for JWT token. Backend calls Zitadel token endpoint internally, returns JWT to frontend.

interface.name: React Context for Authentication
interface.signature: AuthContext with provider, useAuth() hook, methods: login(code), logout(), refreshToken()
interface.description: Central authentication context for storing JWT token, user info, and auth methods. Consumed by protected route guards and other components needing auth state.

interface.name: Protected Route Component
interface.signature: ProtectedRoute component that wraps protected pages, checks for valid token, redirects to /login if absent
interface.description: Route wrapper that ensures user is authenticated before accessing protected pages. Redirects to /login if token missing or expired.

tests.standards: Unit tests use Jest + React Testing Library. Integration tests verify Zitadel redirect and callback flow. Manual testing required with real Zitadel instance.
